name: 𝗛𝗼𝗰𝗼 𝗛𝗖𝟮 𝗫𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗕𝗹𝘂𝗲𝘁𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗵 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗿
description:
Hoco HC2 Xpress – Best Budget Bluetooth Speaker 🎵

For amazing sound quality and powerful beats on a budget, the Hoco HC2 Xpress Bluetooth speaker is the perfect choice. With IPX5 waterproof certification and a convenient carry strap, it’s portable and ideal for outdoor use.

Features:

Bluetooth V5.0 technology and 2400mAh battery, supporting up to 6 hours of calls and music playback.

Multiple playback modes: BT, FM, TF card, AUX, and USB.

IPX5 waterproof and equipped with a carry strap, perfect for outdoor sports and travel.

Specifications:

Brand: Hoco

Model: HC2

Bluetooth Version: V5.0

Battery Capacity: 2400mAh

Play Time: Up to 6 hours

Speaker Unit: 52mm², Power 5W

Supported Modes: BT, TF Card, USB, AUX, FM
